title: Pure World Chalice
summary: Pure World Chalice Link-climb build with generic staples and co-link bosses. It converts its three Normal Monsters (Beckoned, Chosen, and Crowned by the World Chalice) into Imduk the World Chalice Dragon, Ib the World Chalice Justiciar, and a full co-linked board.

summary.title: Starters
points: Lee the World Chalice Fairy searches any World Chalice monster on Normal or Special Summon, and sends a monster from the hand or field to the GY to recover itself from the GY.

Beckoned by the World Chalice, Chosen by the World Chalice, and Crowned by the World Chalice are Normal Monsters that Link Summon Imduk the World Chalice Dragon, which grants an extra Normal Summon of a World Chalice monster in addition to your regular Normal Summon.
World Legacy - "World Chalice", when Normal Summoned/Set and later sent from the field to the GY, Special Summons any two World Chalice monsters from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Normal Monster + World Legacy - "World Chalice"
steps: Normal Summon a World Chalice Normal Monster and Link Summon Imduk the World Chalice Dragon.
Use Imduk's extra World Chalice Normal Summon to Tribute Imduk for World Legacy - "World Chalice" (while Imduk's floating effect Special Summons another World Chalice from your hand).

Link Summon Ib the World Chalice Priestess or Auram the World Chalice Blademaster using World Legacy - "World Chalice", triggering it in the GY to Special Summon Lee the World Chalice Fairy and World Chalice Guardragon from the Deck.

Use Lee to search a World Chalice monster and Guardragon in the GY to revive a Normal Monster as a Tuner for Level 5 Synchro Tuner Ib the World Chalice Justiciar, which searches World Legacy's Heart or World Legacy Discovery and floats into another World Chalice from the Deck or GY.

summary.title: Link Floating Chain
summary.text: Imduk the World Chalice Dragon, Ib the World Chalice Priestess, Auram the World Chalice Blademaster, and Ningirsu the World Chalice Warrior all share the same floating effect: whenever they are sent from the field to the GY, each Special Summons a World Chalice monster from your hand. Coupled with Lee the World Chalice Fairy returning from the GY to the hand, every Link step replaces the material it used.

summary.title: Bosses & Co-Link Payoff
points: Ningirsu the World Chalice Warrior draws a card on Link Summon for each World Chalice monster linked to it, and once per turn sends one card from each side of the field to the GY without targeting or destroying.
Ib the World Chalice Priestess cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while linked, and prevents the opponent from targeting linked monsters you control with card effects.
Tri-Gate Wizard, easily co-linked to three World Chalice Links, gains doubled battle damage at 1 co-link, a once-per-turn card banish at 2 co-links, and an omni-negate that banishes at 3 co-links.
World Chalice Guardragon Almarduke can be Special Summoned from the Extra Deck by Tributing three Link Monsters and attacks all monsters the opponent controls once each.

summary.title: Spells
points: World Legacy's Heart adds two World Chalice monsters with different names from the GY to the hand, and banishes itself from the GY to save a linked Link Monster from battle destruction.

World Legacy Discovery boosts all World Chalice monsters by 300 ATK/DEF and revives a World Chalice monster in Defense Position once per turn when a linked World Chalice monster is destroyed by battle.

main: Searches any World Chalice monster; returns from the GY.
Summons two World Chalice monsters from the Deck when it leaves; searches a World Legacy.
Level 4 Normal: Imduk material and Justiciar's Tuner.
Negates a card that targets your linked monster; revives a Normal.

Link-2: tributes a World Chalice to revive any monster.
Link-2: protects itself and what it points to.
Link-3: draws per World Chalice; sends a card from each field.
